clauses.reason: Terminated by Executive Order 12553, signed February 25, 1986, which orders that the listed Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked, with no stated delayed effective date and no saving clause; the effective date is therefore the signing date, 1986-02-25. The table of revoked orders in the held text of Executive Order 12553 lists number 10010 with the subject "Creating an emergency board to investigate railroad labor disputes". This order created a board of three members to investigate the dispute between the Akron & Barberton Belt Railroad Company and other carriers named in List A and employees represented by the sixteen railway labor organizations named in List B, barred interested members, required a report within thirty days of October 18, 1948 (due by November 17, 1948), and froze changes in conditions from that date until thirty days after the report. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines, the report deadline and the end of the standstill are spent facts, functionally spent after the board reported and the standstill ran, and they are not the end; the order remained on the books until this express revocation. Executive Order 10015 amended this order, adding six carriers to List A and renaming two List B organizations, effective as of October 18, 1948; that amendment is a later event, not an end, because it left the order in force, and it is recorded on the clause (before: the lists as attached to this order; after: the lists as amended by Executive Order 10015). The Executive Order 10015 text used is an American Presidency Project transcription captured by Common Crawl on 2024-10-03; its page record names the order number, date and subject and its text hash matches the held file.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text is the order itself (heading and body read in full; signed October 18, 1948). Inventory read and confirmed (correction only where stated). End: express revocation by Executive Order 12553 on 1986-02-25 under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (report deadline option C): a report deadline and an expired standstill are not ends. Prior research: the packet reports no prior claim or review for this order. Searches: current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog, all complete with no coverage warning.

The actual report date and standstill expiry are not recorded as later events because no reviewed factual-event record for this order's report is in the packet; any report text found in the repository is unreviewed context. The dossier's chain of later events, its three selected machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR, Federal Register catalog dispositions, each marked complete) and my reading of the held text of Executive Order 12553 show no revoking, superseding or terminating instrument before 1986-02-25, and the only amendment is Executive Order 10015, recorded as a later event.","independent_command_check":"Each command (create the board, bar interested members, require the report, freeze conditions) depends on the order and on the dispute it created; none is a separate delegation, continuing regulation or standing rule. savings.reason: No saving or transition provision appears in the held text of Executive Order 12553; the order's one-time commands were performed or lapsed, and the statute it applied (Railway Labor Act section 10) continues independently without needing this order.
